tex_content.label: bigell
tex_content.html: For every $\ell <\infty $ there are $A_0=A_0(\ell )$ and $0<\theta _0=\theta _0(\ell )<1$ such that, for $A\geq A_0$ and sufficiently small surgery control, the following holds. Let a surgery cap of scale $h$ and tip $p$ evolve on $P(p,\bar t,Ah,T'-\bar t)$, where $T'=\min (T,\bar t+\theta _0h^2)$. A backward-time curve in this closure from the final slice or its outer boundary to $B(p,\bar t,Ah/2)$ at a time $t'\in [\bar t,\bar t+h^2/2]$ satisfies \[ \int _0^{T'-t'}\bigl(R(\gamma (\tau ))+|X_\gamma (\tau )|^2\bigr)\, d\tau >\ell . \]
